node.title: Isotypic refinement: escape iff multi-isotypic (x1)
node.statement: [transcribed 2026-07-27 from the upstream source read via git -C ../rs-mca show origin/main:experimental/notes/roadmaps/proof_sketch/s3b_ii_strip_periodic.md#1, tagged 'PROVED-cited']. THE ISOTYPIC REFINEMENT: the confinement/equivariance bridge is EXACT only on the equivariant stratum. Multi-isotypic words on K_M-stable supports produce slopes that ESCAPE confinement — established by a verified witness on main. Hence support-periodicity implies line-periodicity only after restricting to the equivariant (single-isotypic) stratum.
